mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coin_transaction (user_id, type, paid_amount, bonus_amount, balance_after, block_id, purchase_id, note, external_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{paidAmount}, #{bonusAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{blockId}, #{purchaseId}, #{note}, #{externalId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coin_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coin_transaction WHERE external_id = #{externalId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block_purchase (buyer_id, block_id, creator_id, price, bonus_coins, paid_coins, creator_share) VALUES (#{buyerId}, #{blockId}, #{creatorId}, #{price}, #{bonusCoins}, #{paidCoins}, #{creatorShare})
mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.price), 0) AS sold_coins, COALESCE(SUM(p.bonus_coins), 0) AS bonus_coins, COALESCE(SUM(p.creator_share), 0) AS earned_coins, COALESCE(SUM(p.creator_share) FILTER (WHERE p.settlement_id IS NULL), 0) AS pending_coins, COALESCE(SUM(p.creator_share) FILTER (WHERE p.settlement_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS settled_coins
mapper.select: SELECT p.creator_id, u.nickname, u.email, FROM block_purchase p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.creator_id GROUP BY p.creator_id, u.nickname, u.email ORDER BY pending_coins DESC, sales_count DESC, p.creator_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO creator_settlement (creator_id, coins, krw, note) VALUES (#{creatorId}, #{coins}, #{krw}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE block_purchase SET settlement_id = #{settlementId} WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND settlement_id IS NULL AND creator_share > 0
